relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: In our study, galcanezumab significantly reduced caregiver RSS values and also improved the reciprocity and shared activities from the caregiver's point of view.

key_findings: After 6 months of galcanezumab, monthly migraine days fell and caregiver Relatives' Stress Scale scores decreased (p=0.027).
